cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you leave me in the new flat, count five breaths with me. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Not yet. Five more while I look at the empty kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.
